ownership: LLD-05 defines domain-visible states, actions, warnings and preview payloads. LLD-10 owns concrete components, layout, responsive behavior, focus, keyboard interaction, working copies and confirmation widgets.

row_fields: reviewed envelope in selected Objective timezone
rules: monthly ordinal is visually secondary to stable tracking identity
multi-customer/multi-RFC context is explicit but never visually implies a temporal partition
archived unfinished safety state remains discoverable through Needs Attention even if hidden from ordinary list

objective_creation.ui_draft_state: may temporarily contain zero Tasks but has no Objective identity/tracking id/persisted row until CreateObjectiveFromPreview commits
objective_creation.minimum_commit: at least one Task with a complete accepted/prospective interval
task_sources: review WFM source plan as scheduling candidate
preview_states: exact-touch separate with optional manual merge
objective_creation.rule: editing an Objective envelope never silently overwrites member Task plans; the editor is expressed as reviewed Task plan changes plus regroup preview

derived_context: Inventory summary only through future LLD-07 Task relationships

temporal_layers.mismatch: when current Task plan differs from membership pin, show both intervals and PLAN_MEMBERSHIP_MISMATCH; never visually replace pinned interval before regroup acceptance
temporal_layers.unknown: unknown source/execution times display as unknown, never substituted from reviewed_at or plan

execution_flow.objective_start: requires explicit nonempty selection of member Tasks to start; UI must state that unselected Tasks will remain unstarted
execution_flow.awaiting_review: display/projection state, not a selectable accepted Task outcome
execution_flow.whole_objective_cancel: enabled only when preview proves no member Task ever began accepted execution
execution_flow.mixed: show per-Task outcomes; do not offer an Objective-level override that erases mixed truth

must_show: current plan revision and membership pin
consolidation survivor and superseded Objective identities
grouping_review.large_diff: paged/virtualized exact detail with exact totals; acceptance binds persisted proposal rather than loaded page
grouping_review.rejection: reasoned rejection stores minimized fingerprint; UI offers explicit Reconsider when the material fingerprint is unchanged
grouping_review.exact_touch: automatic preview keeps separate; optional manual merge is explicit and reviewed

wfm_source_terminal_review.trigger: accepted provider Complete or Plan Cancel while local executable work/consequence still exists
wfm_source_terminal_review.warning: provider terminal evidence has already been accepted as source evidence; this decision controls only local Task consequence and does not alter provider status

must_show: explicit statement: no execution/outcome/Device/Inventory consequence will be created
historical_objective_review.acceptance: if no operational plan exists, explain that the exact accepted source interval will become a dedicated historical structure plan revision; if a different operational plan exists, block acceptance and route to plan reconciliation
historical_objective_review.operational_counts: individual historical Task inclusion toggle is separate from structure acceptance

retry_review.local: show predecessor immutable attempt, proposed new Task identity placeholder, new independent interval, selectable current SR/RFC/Device links, and future LLD-07 eligible Inventory relationship selections when available
retry_review.wfm: requires separately existing distinct TK attempt; UI only links reviewed retry lineage
retry_review.rule: never present retry as reopening/resetting the old Task or cloning an Objective identity

timezone.ambiguous_input: require explicit first/second occurrence choice or offset in DST fold
timezone.nonexistent_input: block with actionable timezone-gap error; no automatic shift
timezone.rule: wall-clock preservation across timezone change is offered only as separate reviewed reschedule

history_and_destructive_actions.hard_delete: only surface after exact eligibility preview; unavailable with protected history
history_and_destructive_actions.last_task_removal: if it would empty a manual untouched Objective, UI must atomically offer/delete that Objective through exact preview; otherwise block OBJECTIVE_EMPTY
history_and_destructive_actions.correction: select exact prior plan/execution/outcome evidence; show preserved prior evidence and resulting projection before commit

accessibility_handoff: all domain actions require keyboard-equivalent interaction under LLD-10
warnings use text/icon/state not color alone
responsive presentation cannot remove source/current/pinned/actual temporal distinctions or hide exact proposal totals
